drawing: Use clear silhouettes and deliberate variation between outer contours and interior lines.
Group hair into readable masses; use only folds that explain the pose.
Make joint structure, grip, contact and object occlusion legible. Repair interacting hands and held objects together.
Use white space in close shots and a few location contours in wide shots.
avoid: Uniform microdetail, glossy gradients, dense decorative hatching, random grain and redundant highlights.
Any readable text, logos, fake UI copy, real patient names or numbers on screens, papers or signs.
Medical equipment, prescriptions or imagery that implies a diagnosis or treatment.

title: A Better Way to Care — Welbuk
style: Full-colour, approachable Indian slice-of-life manga. Clean confident line art with varied line weight, soft flat cel shading, warm natural daylight, restrained blue and teal accents, simple readable backgrounds. Expressive but natural faces, precise hands. No photorealism, no glossy gradients, no surface microtexture. Absolutely no text, letters, logos, numbers, speech bubbles or captions inside the artwork; device screens show only abstract blank blocks and simple icons.
